biotools.summary: PK-Zernike is a Python implementation of the Pozo-Koehl algorithm for calculating Zernike-Canterakis moments from unstructured surface meshes, primarily intended for protein structure retrieval. It offers a fast and well-documented alternative for calculating ZC moments without external binaries.
